summary: r3 (FINAL allowed cycle) revision of M3.18. axc verify = static CPU-only annotation/consistency checker (front-end only, zero GPU, zero codegen). axc test --fuzz = precondition-satisfying input fuzzer whose oracle is the M3.17 debug-check runtime machinery (dispatch_debug_checked). Both are pure driver-layer orchestration over existing GPU-proven code. Architecture/scope/AT-range UNCHANGED from r1/r2 (AT-2881..2899). r3 applies the r2 pessimistic NEEDS_REVISION spec-text fixes + the r2 optimistic line-item (AT-2893 exit 1->3). Compiler changes: ZERO (one driver-crate pub(crate) bump does not breach the gate).

r3_changelog.architecture_unchanged: verify C1-C5, the fuzz oracle triad (a/b/c), the interval satisfier (integer path), the --violate leg (alpha-pin), the CLI surface, reuse-over-duplication, the files-to-create/modify list, and the zero-compiler-change gate all STAND from r2. No redesign, no scope change, AT range still AT-2881..2899. Every r3 edit is spec-text only.
r3_changelog.C-1new_f32_precision: ALL open-bound interior computation AND the host re-check are now in f32 (the ONLY DebugCheck float type — ty.rs:23, hir.rs:157), NEVER f64. Open lower bound AT 0 -> floor at f32::MIN_POSITIVE (FTZ-safe, survives flush-to-zero). General open bounds -> f32::next_up()/next_down() (or an f32-bit-increment fallback), never an f64 nextafter. The host re-check evaluates the predicate on the std430-decoded f32 bytes ACTUALLY SENT to the GPU (byte-identical value), never an f64 re-derivation. Stated prominently in BOTH sec 3.4 (sampling) and sec 3.5 (discriminator). This makes precondition_check_miscompiled discrimination sound (no f32<->f64 rounding artifact can masquerade as a miscompile or an endpoint-flake).
r3_changelog.C-2new_deferred_condition_exemption: Two-ScalarRef relational preconditions ARE lowered and CAN fire (lower.rs:587) but the satisfier DEFERS them. The discriminator now attributes each fired flag_words[0] bit to its condition (DebugCheck.bit) and, BEFORE the 4-quadrant table, EXEMPTs any bit belonging to a deferred/unconstrained condition => NEW verdict UNCONSTRAINED_PRECONDITION_FIRED, SKIPPED-class, exit 0, with a warning note listing the condition(s) + scalars, reason.kind = unconstrained_precondition_fired. DECISION & JUSTIFICATION: exit 0 (SKIPPED-class) chosen because the deferral is a documented honest v1 limitation (relational_constraint_deferred, sec 3.4) the satisfier openly disclaims; its firing is neither satisfier_unsound (no promise broken) nor miscompile-suspect (the check fired correctly on an unconstrained input). A strict CI can still gate on the distinct verdict string (CI keys on verdict). Folded into AT-2892 + a new sec 10 edge case.
r3_changelog.AT-2893_exit_3: Optimistic reviewer line-item: AT-2893 exit 1 -> exit 3, making the AT table consistent with sec 3.5 and sec 3.6 (exit_code_for_fuzz: UNSATISFIABLE -> 3 everywhere).
r3_changelog.fix-4_discriminator_totality: The host re-check is now UNCONDITIONAL (runs every run), so all four host x GPU quadrants are defined over the CONSTRAINED-condition subset (deferred-exemption applied first): [SATISFIED,clean]=>run PASSES(exit0); [SATISFIED,fired]=>precondition_check_miscompiled(FAIL,exit1); [UNSATISFIED,fired]=>satisfier_unsound(ERROR,exit2); [UNSATISFIED,clean]=>satisfier_unsound_or_check_inert(ERROR,exit2). The 4th quadrant is the r3 addition: it catches the inert/missing-check case (a check that should have fired but did not) AND an unsound satisfier. Folded into AT-2891.
r3_changelog.fix-5_AT-2897_proven_firing_pin: AT-2897 pins a PROVEN-FIRING (seed, --scalar-window, runs) triple at IMPLEMENTATION time: the Coder measures once (widened window --scalar-window>=1024, confirm a run's alpha draw lands in [1000, window] and the postcondition fires), then PINS that exact triple as AT constants. Seeded deterministic sampling (StdRng::seed_from_u64(seed^scalar_position^run)) makes the triple stable across machines/CI; a toolchain RNG-stream change => re-measure and re-pin. The AT is a deterministic assertion, not a probabilistic one.
r3_changelog.loc: sec 12 total nudged ~1330 -> ~1355 (discriminator helper grew ~30 -> ~55 for the f32 std430 re-check + 4-quadrant totality + defer-exemption). Cap ~1700 unchanged.

technical_spec: See .pipeline/milestones/M3.18-verify-fuzz.md (r3) for the full spec + r3-changelog (then r2-changelog). Highlights: (1) verify runs lex/parse/HIR only, inspects BOTH the raw AST (@strict presence + arity-not-1 silent drop) and lowered HIR; PASS iff zero errors; warnings never fail. (2) The M3.17 arity-not-1 silent drop (lower.rs:118/142) is surfaced FROM THE AST, leaving compile byte-identical (AT-2883 control + r2 differential pin). (3) fuzz oracle is the honest triad ONLY, decoded via dispatch_debug_checked's flag_words ([pre_bits, post_bits]) (r2/C-1); flag_words[1]!=0 => postcondition_violation FAIL. flag_words[0] classification (r3): the host re-check is UNCONDITIONAL and in f32 on the std430-decoded bytes ACTUALLY SENT (C-1new); deferred (two-ScalarRef relational) fired bits are EXEMPT => UNCONSTRAINED_PRECONDITION_FIRED (SKIPPED-class, exit 0, C-2new); the CONSTRAINED subset uses the 4-quadrant table [host-SAT/clean=>PASS; host-SAT/fired=>precondition_check_miscompiled FAIL exit1; host-UNSAT/fired=>satisfier_unsound ERROR exit2; host-UNSAT/clean=>satisfier_unsound_or_check_inert ERROR exit2] (fix-4). (4) satisfier is per-scalar interval arithmetic over single-ScalarRef-vs-Lit; i128 for U32/I32; f32 (NOT f64, C-1new) open/closed interval for F32 with strict-interior draws for open bounds (open-at-0 floor f32::MIN_POSITIVE FTZ-safe; general open via f32::next_up/next_down); unsat on lo>hi/pin-conflict/single-excluded-point; two-ScalarRef relational => deferred with note. Value gen seeded within a bounded window (default 256, --scalar-window); no scalar<->buffer-size semantics => surfaced honestly as leg-(a) device_fault. (5) opt-in --violate leg (non-size-coupled scalars only; fixture pins alpha per r2/W-1) negates one precondition and asserts its flag_words[0] bit fires. Interfaces: `axc verify <file> [--json]`, `axc test --fuzz <file> [--runs N] [--seed S] [--debug-oracle] [--violate] [--buffer-sizes|--size] [--workgroups] [--scalar-window W]`; MCP deferred. Exit codes: verify PASS0/FAIL1/ERROR2; fuzz PASS|SKIPPED|UNCONSTRAINED_PRECONDITION_FIRED 0/FAIL1/ERROR2/UNSATISFIABLE3 (r2/r3 distinct), CI keys on verdict.

correctness_oracle: No perf claim. (1) verify check-runner is pure over AST+HIR, each diagnostic unit-asserted (AT-2881..2887); compile-unchanged guarded by AT-2883 control + differential arity pin. (2) fuzz satisfier: every sampled value differentially re-checked against the source predicate in f32 for floats (AT-2891, r3/C-1new — the SAME host evaluator the discriminator reuses); unsat asserted on conflict fixtures (AT-2889/2893); f32 strict-interior open-bound sampling asserted (AT-2890/2896) — never trusted correct-by-construction. (3) fuzz runtime oracle reuses the GPU-proven M3.17 flag decode via dispatch_debug_checked (AT-2870..2873 lineage); M3.18 asserts the exact flag_words mask on real GPUs (AT-2896/2897/2899). The precondition discriminator is TOTAL (r3/fix-4: unconditional host re-check => all 4 host x GPU quadrants defined, catching both satisfier-unsound and inert-check) and DEFER-EXEMPT (r3/C-2new: deferred relational fired bits => UNCONSTRAINED_PRECONDITION_FIRED, not a defect). AT-2897 is the guard proving the oracle actually REPORTS violations. @equiv_fp_tol(1e-3) + production kernels untouched.

UNSATISFIABLE detected on CPU before any Vulkan probe => exit 3 (r2/r3 distinct), deterministic in CI without GPU (AT-2893)

Fuzzed scalar drives OOB (no scalar<->buffer-size semantics) => surfaced honestly as leg-(a) device_fault, never a hidden pass; --violate leg-(a) device_fault classification ships designed-but-unexercised (r2/W-1)

Deferred relational precondition fires (r3/C-2new): a two-ScalarRef gt(a,b) bit fires because the satisfier sampled its scalars in the default window; the fuzzer attributes the fired bit (DebugCheck.bit) and emits UNCONSTRAINED_PRECONDITION_FIRED (SKIPPED-class, exit 0, warning note), NOT satisfier_unsound and NOT precondition_check_miscompiled

Constrained input violates yet no bit fires (r3/fix-4, 4th quadrant): the unconditional f32 host re-check rejects a constrained sampled value but flag_words[0] is clean => satisfier_unsound_or_check_inert (ERROR, exit 2) — satisfier unsound OR the M3.17 check missing/inert; the totality of the discriminator surfaces this otherwise-invisible case

f32-only float reasoning (r3/C-1new): the proved value, the std430-encoded value SENT, and the host-re-checked value are one byte-identical f32 bit pattern; no f32<->f64 rounding artifact can masquerade as a miscompile or an endpoint-flake
